notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is greater than your maximum hand size.
description:
Move to your cleanup step.
Discard down to your maximum hand size, ensuring to discard Blazing Rootwalla.
Blazing Rootwalla is discarded into exile, triggering its madness ability, causing you to pay {0} to cast it from exile.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Blazing Rootwalla.
When Blazing Rootwalla dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Blazing Rootwalla from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Blazing Rootwalla's power.
Once the stack is empty and all players pass priority, another cleanup step occurs.
Repeat from step 2.
